limitations: SDK boundary is a controlled recorder; no real Google IMA ad playback or device acceptance.
Artifact export tests use an already destroyed host; full installed distribution remains task06.
Public declaration and second parameter consumption remain task04; runtime authorization does not waive type compatibility.
Actual core baselines are npm5.1.7/npm5.4.0 and candidate5.4.1; earlier prose claiming published5.4.1 was incorrect.
Initial browser failures preserve the stale workspace-only expectations, not a claim of an IMA vendor regression.
